method: Historical price-return stochastic dominance of orders 1-3. Network: all 72 eligible asset nodes, including PFE once, plus Current once. Current uses the 16 sealed holdings and latest verified EUR valuation weights; invested-holdings returns exclude cash. D=max(OUT+IN) is recomputed on each complete network including this Current portfolio, with all incident reference degrees updated. No fixed archived D and no duplicate PFE candidate. FULL uses the existing training sample; R1-R4 use exact-date retrospective labels without filling. The 126 diagnostic observations are excluded. This is a historical evaluation, not terminal scenario-tree netSD, a new forecast, or reoptimisation of trading policies.
